items.description: Digital 2121 South Price, LLC is the Landlord under the lease, signing as a Delaware limited liability company.
items.name: DIGITAL 2121 SOUTH PRICE, LLC

items.description: Carbonite, Inc. is the Tenant under the lease, signing as a Delaware corporation.
items.name: CARBONITE, INC.

items.description: Tenant must carry commercial general liability insurance with the stated single and aggregate limits plus umbrella excess coverage.
items.span_text: $1,000,000 single limit; $2,000,000 aggregate limit, with umbrella coverage providing an additional $3,000,000 in excess coverage

items.description: Tenant must carry special peril form property insurance covering the full replacement value of its personal property.
items.span_text: Full replacement value of Tenant’s Personal Property.

items.description: Tenant must carry workers' compensation insurance as required by state law and employer's liability insurance with the stated minimum limits.
items.span_text: In accordance with the laws of the state in which the Property is located, and Employer’s Liability insurance with a limit not less than $1,000,000 Bodily Injury Each Accident; $1,000,000 Bodily Injury By Disease - Each Person; and $1,000,000 Bodily Injury By Disease - Policy Limit.

items.description: Tenant must carry primary auto liability insurance covering owned, hired and non-owned vehicles with the stated per-occurrence minimum.
items.span_text: Primary auto liability insurance with limits of not less than $1,000,000 per occurrence covering owned, hired and non-owned vehicles used by Tenant or any other member of the Tenant Group.

items.description: Tenant must carry business interruption insurance reimbursing loss of earnings from insured perils for at least the stated period.
items.span_text: In such amount as will reimburse Tenant for direct or indirect loss of earnings attributable to all perils insured against by the property insurance described above for a period of not less than twelve (12) months.

items.description: Tenant's required insurance must be issued by insurers meeting the stated minimum Best's rating.
items.span_text: All insurance required of Tenant under this Lease shall be issued by insurers with a “General Policyholders Rating” of at least A-, VIII, as set forth in “Best’s Insurance Guide.”

items.description: Landlord must carry commercial general liability insurance with the stated single and aggregate limits plus umbrella excess coverage.
items.span_text: $1,000,000 single limit; $2,000,000 aggregate limit; with an umbrella policy providing an additional $3,000,000 in excess coverage.

items.description: Landlord must carry special peril form property insurance covering the full replacement value of the Building and its installed personal property.
items.span_text: Full replacement value of the Building and Landlord’s personal property installed therein.

items.description: Landlord must carry workers' compensation insurance as required by state law and employer's liability insurance with the stated minimum limits.
items.span_text: In accordance with the laws of the state in which the Property is located, and Employer’s Liability insurance with a limit not less than $1,000,000 Bodily Injury Each Accident; $1,000,000 Bodily Injury By Disease—Each Person; and $1,000,000 Bodily Injury By Disease—Policy Limit.

items.description: Landlord must carry primary auto liability insurance covering owned, hired and non-owned vehicles with the stated per-occurrence minimum.
items.span_text: Primary auto liability insurance with limits of not less than $1,000,000 per occurrence covering owned, hired and non-owned vehicles used by Landlord or any other member of the Landlord Group.

items.description: Landlord's required insurance must be issued by insurers meeting the stated minimum Best's rating.
items.span_text: All insurance required of Landlord under this Lease shall be issued by insurers with a “General Policyholders Rating” of at least A-, VIII, as set forth in “Best’s Insurance Guide.”

items.description: Upon an Event of Default, Landlord may terminate the Lease, and Tenant must then immediately surrender possession of the Tenant Space.
items.span_text: 1.1.1 Terminate this Lease, in which event Tenant shall immediately surrender possession of the Tenant Space to Landlord.
